claims.claim: TSMC Q2 2026 revenue was US$40.20B, up 33.7% year over year, with 67.7% gross margin and 60.3% operating margin; advanced nodes at 7nm and below were 77% of wafer revenue.
August 2026 monthly revenue reached NT$514.806B, up 53.3% year over year; January-August revenue was NT$3.387T, up 39.3%, extending the leading-edge demand signal beyond Q2.

risks.risk: Extreme leading-edge concentration increases exposure to AI-cycle digestion, customer concentration and geopolitically constrained capacity expansion.

unknowns.unknown: This Scout artifact does not establish current valuation or full customer-concentration detail.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 execution exceeded the prior Q2 revenue guidance range at its top end and management guided Q3 revenue to US$44.6B-US$45.8B while citing continued leading-edge demand and steep 2nm ramp.
August monthly revenue growth of 53.3% year over year is consistent with continued near-term execution strength after Q2 rather than an immediate demand rollover.

risks.risk: High current margins and growth create a demanding persistence test as overseas fabs ramp and 2nm capital intensity rises.

unknowns.unknown: Current market valuation and complete balance-sheet/capex normalization inputs remain for Alpha scoring.
